name: Delete Post
description: Removes a post from user's wall. [See the documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/community-management/shares/share-api?tabs=http#delete-shares) for more information

configurable_props.name: postId
configurable_props.label: Post Id
configurable_props.description: URN of the post that will be deleted. URN must be either a ugcPostUrn (`urn:li:ugcPost:{id}`) or shareUrn (`urn:li:share:{id}`). The shareUrn can be found in the post's embed code.
